additional_info.subject: NOte
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I'm contacting you because our base station lost communication with SCB and OCPP on March 31.
After visiting the site, I noticed that:
- the base station won't reboot; it's stuck on the "Hello" page
- all components are connected (IP scan)
- the SCB and OCPP routers have the same version
- the SCB router is correctly configured for SSH
Following a request from Siemens France support, I configured the APN of router 1 to PAP.
Could you please come as soon as possible with a replacement router and the necessary hardware to flash the SIFAST?
Thank you in advance.

I checked the logs because since it was offline I didn't think it was communicating:
We have a lot of these errors, this is due to a CFAST corruption. Please also take a spare CFAST. Flash the CFAST with LiveLinux first and only if it still doesn't work, replace it.
